files.name: Module Glass Preview 1.0.0
files.notes: Live companion app for Module Glass Stable Recovery. Provides Control Center preview, Device Live preference/image changes, Darwin reload notifications, and direct Module Glass log viewing.

files.name: Module Glass 1.1.4 RootHide
files.notes: Hardened Module Glass runtime with state-driven rendering, cached preferences, asynchronous image decoding, exact restoration tracking, live Volume tint updates, Remove Blur, Glow, and expanded-module safety.

files.name: Module Glass 1.1.4 Hardened Source
files.notes: Final hardened Module Glass 1.1.4 source used for the verified RootHide build, including crash-safety and smoothness optimizations.
